acceptanceCriteria: Reproduce on base 6ceee260b..8a21fb19c and attribute the selection to its edges (docs readers, spec index readers, LANGUAGE_FRONTIER).
Each over-broad edge class is either narrowed with a test or recorded as a justified unknown; the selection for this diff drops substantially or the reason is documented.
body: Residual of V1-1866/V1-1867 (PR #1166, head 8a21fb19c, GH #1163/#1164). Lane report: `corvint affected` on a change touching docs/specs/test-source-analysis-v0.md, generated spec index files and internal/testsource selected about 130 units with LANGUAGE_FRONTIER unknowns, too broad to run; lanes then fall back to hand-picked focused tests, which defeats test selection. Related V1-0999 (UNBOUNDED_READER breadth), distinct trigger.
title: corvint affected selects ~130 units for a docs-plus-internal/testsource change
